card.title: How To Fix an iPhone 15 That Randomly Restarts

source.title: How To Fix an iPhone 15 That Randomly Restarts

claims.statement: On iPhone 15 / 15 Plus the bit meanings differ from the Pro: 0x200000 (2097152) = wireless charging flex on the back glass; 0x100000 (1048576) = proximity flex.
0x80000 (524288) = charging port flex and/or air pressure sensor (must be plugged in).
0x280000 = wireless + charge port; 0x380000 = all three; 0xa1 (161) = battery data issue.

procedure: Read the Sensor Array value; decode with the iPhone 15 (non-Pro) mapping.
Check the air pressure sensor is connected for 0x80000.
Test flagged parts with known-good OEM parts; diode-check FPCs.
For 0xa1 work the battery and connector.
card.caveats: Same hex value means different parts on different iPhone models. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
card.component: Back glass / charge port / prox flex
